license: Natural Earth public domain; US states GeoJSON via PublicaMundi (derived from US Census TIGER, public domain).
political_note: 边界按所选数据集绘制，包括争议地区处理方式。本系统不表达主权立场。
projection_note: 前端默认 Web Mercator。极区面积与形状失真；南北约 85° 以外不保证可展示。跨日期变更线国家使用原数据集 MultiPolygon，不把几何静默丢弃。

exceptions.Norway: ISO_A2=-99 in source; mapped via ISO_A2_EH=NO
exceptions.France: ISO_A2=-99 in source; mapped via ISO_A2_EH=FR
exceptions.Kosovo: ISO_A2=-99 in source; mapped to XK as exception, pending ISO status
exceptions.Northern Cyprus: kept as ne:CNX without ISO; disputed, listed in matching notes
exceptions.Somaliland: kept as ne:SOL without ISO; disputed, listed in matching notes

sources.name: Representative points for ISO units missing from 110m polygons
sources.note: 不是病例点。面状几何缺失时提供列表与定位，避免因简化边界静默丢失国家。
